headline: AFF AI CLUB breaks into ARC-3 gold

sections.text: AFF AI CLUB climbed from 31st to 10th at 38.98, up 5.06, and moved into the 18 gold places. AI_hwlee slipped from 18th to 19th at 36.54, falling just outside.
The swap puts AFF AI CLUB inside the public medal band while leaving AI_hwlee 0.35 below the 36.89 cutoff. The board remains provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
